function f() {}
const label = (f.label = 'first');
console.log(label, f.label);
console.log(f.label = 'second');
function g() {}
const nested = (g.first = (g.second = 'two'));
console.log(nested, g.first, g.second);
const constant = () => 3;
const result = (constant.description = 'constant');
console.log(result, constant.description, constant());
function outer() {}
{
  const outer = () => 4;
  const result = (outer.local = 'local');
  console.log(result, outer.local, outer());
}
console.log(outer.global = 'global');
console.log(outer.global);
